## MapOverlap3D {#sec-mapoverlap3d-documentation}

### `MapOverlap(UF(Region3D))`
Creates a `MapOverlap3D` instance with the supplied user function.
```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region3D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        for (int j = -r.oj; j <= r.oj; ++j)
            for (int k = -r.ok; k <= r.ok; ++k)
                val += r(i, j, k);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
}
```

### `operator()`
Calls the `MapOverlap3D` instance, performing the user function on the input parameters, and stores the result in the output containers.

```{.cpp .run}
#include <skepu>
#include <skepu-lib/io.hpp>

int sum(skepu::Region3D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        for (int j = -r.oj; j <= r.oj; ++j)
            for (int k = -r.ok; k <= r.ok; ++k)
                val += r(i, j, k);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    skepu::Tensor3<int> in(5, 5, 5, "", 1), out(5, 5, 5);

    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);

    regionSum(out, in);
    skepu::io::cout << out(2, 2, 2) << "\n";
}
```

```{.text .output}
27
```

### `setOverlap(int oi, int oj, int ok)`
Sets the overlap radius for the `MapOverlap3D` instance. Is set to 1 by default in each dimension. Cannot be less than 0. `oi` is the outermost dimension.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region3D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        for (int j = -r.oj; j <= r.oj; ++j)
            for (int k = -r.ok; k <= r.ok; ++k)
                val += r(i, j, k);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    regionSum.setOverlap(2, 2, 2);
}
```

### `setOverlap(int o)`
Calls `setOverlap(o, o, o)`.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region3D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        for (int j = -r.oj; j <= r.oj; ++j)
            for (int k = -r.ok; k <= r.ok; ++k)
                val += r(i, j, k);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    regionSum.setOverlap(2);
}
```

### `getOverlap() -> std::tuple<int, int, int>`
Returns a tuple of the current overlap radius in each dimension of the `MapOverlap3D` instance.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region3D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        for (int j = -r.oj; j <= r.oj; ++j)
            for (int k = -r.ok; k <= r.ok; ++k)
                val += r(i, j, k);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    std::tuple<int, int, int> overlap = regionSum.getOverlap();
}
```

### `setStride(int si, int sj, int sk)`
Sets the stride for the dimensions of the `MapOverlap3D` instance. Is set to 1 by default in each dimension. Cannot be less than 0. `si` is the outermost dimension.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region3D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        for (int j = -r.oj; j <= r.oj; ++j)
            for (int k = -r.ok; k <= r.ok; ++k)
                val += r(i, j, k);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    regionSum.setStride(2, 2, 2);
}
```

### `setStride(int s)`
Calls `setStride(s, s, s)`.

```cpp
#include <skepu>

int sum(skepu::Region3D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        for (int j = -r.oj; j <= r.oj; ++j)
            for (int k = -r.ok; k <= r.ok; ++k)
                val += r(i, j, k);
    return val;
}

int main()
{
    auto regionSum = skepu::MapOverlap(sum);
    regionSum.setStride(2);
}
```

### `getStride() -> std::tuple<int, int, int>`
Returns a tuple of the current stride in each dimension of the `MapOverlap3D` instance.

```cpp

int sum(skepu::Region3D<int> r)
{
    int val = 0;
    for (int i = -r.oi; i <= r.oi; ++i)
        for (int j = -r.oj; j <= r.oj; ++j)
            for (int k = -r.ok; k <= r.ok; ++k)

int main()
```
